name: Miraeui Yeochinnimi Naege Insareul Geonnewatda
source:
My life had only known solitude. But one day, a strange girl suddenly came up to say hello.

"Nice to meet you! I'm your girlfriend from the future!"

This is a story of the four days with my so-called future girlfriend.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/976420/____My_socalled_future_girlfriend/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我的人生向来只有孤独。可某天，一个陌生女孩突然走上前来，向我打招呼。

“初次见面！我是你未来的女朋友！”

这是我与这位所谓的未来女友，共同度过四天的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/976420/____My_socalled_future_girlfriend/]Steam[/url]]
